features: Eagle Eye Cloud Managed Video Recorder (CMVR): stores video locally and acts as a gateway to the Eagle Eye cloud
Video encrypted in transit and at rest
Datasheet: Bridges and CMVRs support ONVIF Profile S IP cameras
Max cameras: 8 Analog (NTSC/PAL) or up to 20 IP cameras @4MP (typical)
Datasheet: Combo CMVRs support IP as well as NTSC and PAL analog cameras
Storage capacity: 4 TB (35 days for 20 cameras @ 1MP)
Power consumption is the stated maximum
